## Previously {#fm4-previously .fm-slide }

For $\$2000$ at 6% per year, three annual increases give:

$$2000\times1.06\times1.06\times1.06$$

**How can we write the repeated multiplication more compactly?**

::: {.fragment .takeaway}
$$2000(1.06)^3$$
:::

::: notes
Give thinking time before advancing the fragment. The exponent counts the number of identical percentage multiplications, not the number of amounts in the list.
:::
